desc:
Baboon Tag Ultra is a fast-paced tag game where you play as a monkey, running, jumping, and climbing through various environments. Navigate different maps while avoiding being tagged!

🎮 Features:
🌲 Expansive Maps – Explore the jungle, caves, city, and more!
🏃 Game Modes – Play Infection and try not to get tagged!
🛍️ Cosmetics – Customize your monkey with unique hats and badges!

⭐ Like & favorite the game if you enjoy it!

Tags: Gorilla, Tag, Parkour, Monkey, Baboon, VR, Fast-Paced, Tag Games, Competitive, Multiplayer, GTU, BTU
